subject: Knit2pdf works locally but not on shinyapp.io server

messages.author: 478607519c2c5712
messages.subject: Knit2pdf works locally but not on shinyapp.io server
parts:
I have an app (peppro.org) that generates a pdf report after the user has analysed his/her data. knit2pdf() works fine in my laptop but I can't get it to work as long as when I upload it to the shinyapp.io server. It looks like "myPDF.rnw" can be converted to "myPDF.tex", but there's some issues converting from "myPDF.tex" to "myPDF.pdf".


However, if I simply comment out everything in "myPDF.rnw", making it an empty PDF with only some plane text, I'm able to generate the pdf again on shinyapp.io. I'm not sure where the problem is. The main error message I get from the shinyapp log is this:


 "Warning: Error in : Failed to compile makePDF.tex. See makePDF.log for more info.".


It is said in another post that reactive values are not allowed in .Rnw files, but I've seen Yihui's example where he printed two input$*** in the pdf. So I don't think that is the reason.


Any ideas will be more than welcome!



The whole error message looks like below:
